proof_scope: local deterministic Excalidraw toolkit validation, animation-token binding, create-svg scene compilation, create-svg SVG rendering, and fail-closed invalid board handling

claims.proves: the skill can validate its reusable Excalidraw library, compile a board with movable animation tokens into create-svg scene/timeline input, render that scene through create-svg, and reject an uncompileable board
claims.does_not_prove: every arbitrary Excalidraw layout, live browser editing, Excalimate compatibility, or final create-svg browser verification

cases.name: toolkit-generates-reusable-library
command:
T=$(mktemp -d) && ../run.sh toolkit --output $T/toolkit.excalidrawlib | tee $T/out.json && python3 - $T/out.json $T/toolkit.excalidrawlib <<'PYCODE'
import json,sys
receipt=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
lib=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
if receipt['status']!='PASS' or receipt['animation_tokens']<5:
    raise SystemExit(receipt)
if lib['type']!='excalidrawlib' or len(lib['libraryItems'])<7:
    raise SystemExit('bad library')
print('OPS_EXCALIDRAW_TOOLKIT_OK', receipt['animation_tokens'])
PYCODE

cases.name: compile-board-emits-create-svg-timeline
unbound-animation-token-fails-closed
command:
T=$(mktemp -d) && python3 - <<'PYCODE' > $T/bad.excalidraw
import json
print(json.dumps({'type':'excalidraw','version':2,'elements':[{'id':'anim','type':'diamond','x':0,'y':0,'width':50,'height':50,'isDeleted':False,'groupIds':[],'customData':{'opsExcalidraw':{'kind':'animation','preset':'pulse','startMs':0,'durationMs':500}}}], 'appState':{}, 'files':{}}))
PYCODE
../run.sh compile $T/bad.excalidraw $T/out.yml
